surfaceGeology.note: The USGS global geology map supplies the mapped-unit backbone; quantitative unit-area statistics can be generated from the vector GIS package later.

geologicAge.note: Planned: Copernican, Eratosthenian, Imbrian, Nectarian and Pre-Nectarian surface shares from the global geologic map.

topography.note: Planned: LOLA/Kaguya elevation, slope, relief and near-side/far-side summaries.

crustGravity.note: Planned: GRAIL gravity and crust-thickness summaries.

mineralogy.note: Planned: M3/Diviner/Lunar Prospector mineralogical and elemental diagnostics.

volcanism.note: Planned: mare basalt, pyroclastic deposits, domes and young volcanic features.

tectonics.note: Planned: lobate scarps, wrinkle ridges, graben and Apollo-era moonquake context.

polarVolatiles.note: Planned: permanent shadow, hydrogen/water-ice and cold-trap diagnostics.

returnedSamples.note: Planned: Apollo/Luna/Chang'e sample-return sites and returned lithologies.

sources.label: USGS Unified Geologic Map of the Moon, 1:5M, v2
